en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It is narrated that there was a rich man. When he saw the moon of Zilhajj, he observed fast on the next day. When this news  reached  the  Holy  Prophet  (s.a.w.s.),  he  called  that person and asked, “Why did you observe fast on that day?”
He replied, “May my parents be sacrificed on you, these are the days of Mash-a’r and Hajj. I hope Allah includes me also in their prayers.”

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “You will get  the  reward  of  freeing  a  slave,  sacrificing  a  hundred camels and carrying  the load on a  hundred horses  in the way  of  Allah  for  each fast.  When  Yaum-e-Tarweeya  (8th Zilhajj) arrives you will get the reward of freeing a thousand slaves, sacrificing a thousand camels and carrying load in the  way  of  Allah  on  a  thousand  horses.  You  will  get  the  reward  of  freeing  two  thousand  slaves,  sacrificing  two thousand camels and carrying load in the way of Allah on two thousand horses for the fast of the day of Arafah. All these are compensation for the sins of sixty years before and after it, in your life.”
